# Module: `icescopy_neural_detection`

Loads ONNX droplet models and runs CPU inference with optional guidance circles.

[Source](../src/icescopy_neural_detection.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Validates the model metadata and network files before loading them with OpenCV. Averages descriptors from the supplied guidance circles, or uses the model reference when none are given. Predicts circles over overlapping image tiles and removes duplicates and protected objects.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`Circle`](API-Class-icescopy-neural-detection-Circle.md) | Stores a circle center and radius for neural detection. |
| [`ModelConfig`](API-Class-ModelConfig.md) | Holds validated model identity, network paths, and inference settings. |
| [`NeuralDetector`](API-Class-NeuralDetector.md) | Uses reference and detector networks to predict new droplet circles. |
